statements.status_notes: Debian sid libssh2 1.11.1-5 backport fixes Encrypt-then-MAC heap overflow (upstream commit 42e33d81577ed4b95d4b4f6f845e5ee8efe5eeb4). Applied in package/deb/main/libssh2 patch/CVE-2026-66035.patch.

Debian sid libssh2 1.11.1-5 backport adds publickey response bounds checking (upstream commit a13bb6c773f0d55ad1628cede57e99803cd898d9). Applied in package/deb/main/libssh2 patch/CVE-2026-66034.patch.
Debian sid libssh2 1.11.1-5 backport fixes AES-GCM integer underflow (upstream commit a2ed82d40964bbc0d64cd717aa0a5a892117d2e6). Applied in package/deb/main/libssh2 patch/CVE-2026-66033.patch.
Debian sid libssh2 1.11.1-5 backport nulls the SFTP data pointer after free (upstream commit 5e4776146552d898b9c0e1b313cd093fa8dc92d0). Applied in package/deb/main/libssh2 patch/CVE-2026-66032.patch.

Debian sid libssh2 1.11.1-6 backport initializes publickey list entries before use (upstream commit 32092f0d310f4d769e5ed073ad5987f997f446dc). Applied in package/deb/main/libssh2 patch/CVE-2026-58051.patch.
Debian sid libssh2 1.11.1-6 backport caps publickey attribute list size (upstream commit 34497525929b9a47f03dfb81887ac896202b7e12). Applied in package/deb/main/libssh2 patch/CVE-2026-58050.patch.

The DHI libssh2 package backports the upstream transport.c packet_length bounds fix from https://github.com/libssh2/libssh2/commit/97acf3dfda80c91c3a8c9f2372546301d4a1a7a8 as dhi-cve-2026-55200-transport-packet-length-bound.patch, which rejects packets whose length exceeds LIBSSH2_PACKET_MAXPAYLOAD and prevents the out-of-bounds heap write.

The DHI libssh2 package backports the upstream SSH_MSG_EXT_INFO parse-failure fix from https://github.com/libssh2/libssh2/commit/17626857d20b3c9a1addfa45979dadcee1cd84a4 as upstream-cve-2026-55199.patch, which breaks the extension-parsing loop on _libssh2_get_string() failure and prevents the pre-authentication CPU-exhaustion loop.
